summary: 111, Inc. (NASDAQ: YI), a Chinese tech-enabled healthcare platform, disclosed that its board received an unsolicited preliminary non-binding proposal dated September 16, 2026 from a Buyer Group comprising co-founders Dr. Gang Yu and CEO Junling Liu plus Huadeng Tech BioArray Ventures Ltd, to acquire all outstanding Class A shares not already owned at US$0.226 per Class A Share, or US$4.52 per ADS (each ADS representing twenty Class A Shares), in cash. The filing is a US-equivalent going-private proposal via Form 6-K. The Buyer Group intends equity financing through rollover equity plus Sponsor cash contributions. The board has not yet evaluated the proposal, named no advisor, and cautions there is no assurance any definitive offer or agreement will follow. Watch for a special committee formation, independent advisor retention, and any revised price or competing bid.
